The liver should not show focal masses, cysts, abscesses, or areas of abnormal enhancement on a routine scan.
Signs of liver disease may include nodular contour, enlargement or shrinkage, fatty change, or dilated bile ducts.
Comparison with surrounding organs and vessels helps assess liver size, shape, and internal uniformity.
